case_title: SASHA PHOTOGRAPHY LLC VS. SARAH MILLER MITRANI

docket_entries.description: THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT CROSS COMPLAINANT MITRANI, SARAH MILLER IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY CROSS DEFENDANT SASHA PHOTOGRAPHY LLC PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM FAILED TO DEMONSTRATE DEFENDANT'S YELP REVIEW WAS FALSE GIVEN HIS BREACH OF THE CONTRACT AND SPECIFIC ASIAN REFERENCES.
